715120101.text: Did... this area get cleared? Huh... I think it should have been cleared already...

715120103.text: Hmph... You're... the Traveler! My apologies, I was too busy. I didn't even notice you.

715120104.text: What are you so busy with?

715120105.text: Ahem... So, it's like this. For this year's Lantern Rite festival, we of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild have been dispatched by the Ministry of Civil Affairs to help with some tertiary tasks.

715120106.text: The Millelith are primarily responsible for patrolling the city and other key areas. We, on the other hand, get to go out and clear out some monsters... along with those good for nothing bandits too.

715120107.text: Speaking of which, you're a registered adventurer as well, aren't you? I've heard plenty about your exploits.

715120108.text: If you want, you can help us out too. What do you say?

715120111.text: Well... Since we are helping the ministry during a holiday, they're providing additional compensation for our efforts.

715120112.text: So, should any adventurers be willing to take on these commissions, they'll be able to collect more rewards upon completing their tasks...
